reference.title: Cost and Usage Report (CUR) 2.0 - AWS Data Exports

documented_contents: All of the columns that are included in the export.
A list of the export files and their file path.
The time period covered by the export.
A section called additionalOutputFiles that lists the additional files that are delivered if you have Athena or Amazon Redshift integration.
manifest.notes: AWS documents the manifest by prose description only. No JSON schema, key list or example is published; every key except additionalOutputFiles is UNVERIFIED.

TIME_GRANULARITY.schema_effect: changes time granularity of line items

columns.name: bill_bill_type
columns.description: The type of bill that this report covers. There are three bill types: Anniversary: Line items for services that you used during the month. Purchase: Line items for upfront service fees. Refund: Line items for refunds.

columns.name: bill_billing_entity
columns.description: Helps you identify whether your invoices or transactions are for AWS Marketplace or for purchases of other AWS services.

columns.name: bill_billing_period_end_date
columns.description: The end date of the billing period that is covered by this report, in UTC. The format is YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm:ssZ.

columns.name: bill_billing_period_start_date
columns.description: The start date of the billing period that is covered by this report, in UTC. The format is YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm:ssZ.

columns.name: bill_invoice_id
columns.description: The ID associated with a specific line item. Until the report is final, the InvoiceId is blank.

columns.name: bill_invoicing_entity
columns.description: The AWS entity that issues the invoice.

columns.name: bill_payer_account_id
columns.description: The account ID of the paying account. For an organization in AWS Organizations, this is the account ID of the management account.

columns.name: bill_payer_account_name
columns.description: The account name of the paying account. For an organization in AWS Organizations, this is the name of the management account.

columns.name: cost_category
columns.description: A map column containing key-value pairs of the cost categories and their values for a given line item. These keys and values are populated based on the categorization rules you create in the cost categories feature. A cost category key only appears in the map column if it has a value that applies to the specific line item. The keys of this column can be queried as individual columns using the dot operator. For more information, see Data query.

columns.name: capacity_reservation_capacity_reservation_arn
columns.description: Table configuration: Added by: INCLUDE CAPACITY RESERVATION DATA The capacity reservation ARN represents the unique identifier of the capacity reservation

columns.name: capacity_reservation_capacity_reservation_status
columns.description: Table configuration: Added by: INCLUDE CAPACITY RESERVATION DATA Indicates whether the line item represents either the consumption or the cancellation (in the case of Future-dated Capacity reservation) of the capacity reservation identified in the capacity_reservation_capacity_reservation_arn column or when the capacity reservation is unused or when the capacity reservation is reserved.

columns.name: capacity_reservation_capacity_reservation_type
columns.description: Table configuration: Added by: INCLUDE CAPACITY RESERVATION DATA The capacity reservation type field represents the type of capacity reservation purchased. Currently, there are 2 types ODCR and EC2 Capacity Blocks for ML

columns.name: discount
columns.description: Table configuration: Removed by: INCLUDE MANUAL DISCOUNT COMPATIBILITY A "struct" column containing key-value pairs of any specific discounts that apply to this line item. The keys correspond to a discount type and the values correspond to either the discount value or other information. The values in this column are either data type "numeric" or "string" depending on the specific key. The keys of this column can be queried as individual columns by using the dot operator. For more information, see Data query. This column is not available when "Manual discount compatibility" is enabled. When it's enabled, discounts are populated as separate line items and not in this column.

columns.name: discount_bundled_discount
columns.description: The bundled discount applied to the line item. A bundled discount is a usage-based discount that provides free or discounted usage of a service or feature based on the usage of another service or feature. As of August 2025, bundled discounts are applied using an "Owner-first approach" where discounts are first applied to the account that generates the source usage. Within the source account, discounts are applied based on the following sequence: Highest per-unit priceEarlier usage timestampsLarger usage amounts when other factors are equal Any remaining discounts are distributed across other accounts in the Consolidated Billing Family (CBF) based on the following sequence: Highest per-unit priceAscending order of account IdEarlier usage timestampsLarger usage amounts Examples of bundled discounts include: If you use AWS Shield Advanced, then you don't have to pay for AWS WAF separately. AWS WAF usage is bundled with AWS Shield Advanced. For more information about AWS Shield Advanced, see Amazon CloudFront pricing. If you create a NAT gateway with AWS Network Firewall, then the standard NAT gateway processing and per-hour usage charges are waived on a one-to-one basis with the firewall's processing per GB and usage hours. For more information, see AWS Network Firewall pricing. With Amazon Interactive Video Service (IVS) Chat, for every hour of video input sent, you get 2,700 sent messages and 270,000 delivered messages at no additional cost. For more information, see Amazon Interactive Video Service pricing.

columns.name: discount_total_discount
columns.description: Table configuration: Removed by: INCLUDE MANUAL DISCOUNT COMPATIBILITY The sum of all the discount columns for the corresponding line item. This column is not available when "Manual discount compatibility" is enabled. When it's enabled, discounts are populated as separate line items and not in this column.

columns.name: identity_line_item_id
columns.description: This field is generated for each line item and is unique in a given partition. This does not guarantee that the field will be unique across an entire delivery (that is, all partitions in an update) of the AWS CUR. The line item ID isn't consistent between different Cost and Usage Reports and can't be used to identify the same line item across different reports.

columns.name: identity_time_interval
columns.description: The time interval that this line item applies to, in the following format: YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm:ssZ/YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm:ssZ. The time interval is in UTC and can either be daily or hourly, depending on the report granularity.

columns.name: line_item_usage_account_name
columns.description: The name of the account that used this line item. For organizations, this can be either the management account or a member account. You can use this field to track costs or usage by account.

columns.name: line_item_availability_zone
columns.description: The Availability Zone that hosts this line item. For example, us-east-1a or us-east-1b.

columns.name: line_item_blended_cost
columns.description: The BlendedRate multiplied by the UsageAmount. BlendedCost is blank for line items that have a LineItemType of Discount. Discounts are calculated using only the unblended cost of a member account, aggregated by member account and SKU. As a result, BlendedCost is not available for discounts.

columns.name: line_item_blended_rate
columns.description: The BlendedRate is the average cost incurred for each SKU across an organization. For example, the Amazon S3 blended rates are the total cost of storage divided by the amount of data stored per month. For accounts with RIs, the blended rates are calculated as the average costs of the RIs and the On-Demand Instances. Blended rates are calculated at the management account level, and used to allocate costs to each member account. For more information, see Blended Rates and Costs in the AWS Billing User Guide.

columns.name: line_item_currency_code
columns.description: The currency that this line item is shown in. All AWS customers are billed in US dollars by default. To change your billing currency, see Changing which currency you use to pay your bill in the AWS Billing User Guide.

columns.name: line_item_iam_principal
columns.description: The IAM ARN of the principal that performed the Amazon Bedrock model inference. This column is populated when you enable IAM principal data in your CUR 2.0 data export. Currently supported for Amazon Bedrock only.

columns.name: line_item_legal_entity
columns.description: The Seller of Record of a specific product or service. In most cases, the invoicing entity and legal entity are the same. The values might differ for third-party AWS Marketplace transactions. Possible values include: Amazon Web Services, Inc.: The entity that sells AWS services. Amazon Web Services India Private Limited: The local Indian entity that acts as a reseller for AWS services in India.

columns.name: line_item_line_item_description
columns.description: The description of the line item type. For example, the description of a usage line item summarizes the type of usage incurred during a specific time period. For size-flexible RIs, the description corresponds to the RI the benefit was applied to. For example, if a line item corresponds to a t2.micro and a t2.small RI was applied to the usage, the line_item_line_item_description displays t2.small. The description for a usage line item with an RI discount contains the pricing plan covered by the line item.

columns.name: line_item_line_item_type
columns.description: The type of charge covered by this line item. The possible types are as follows: BundledDiscount: A usage-based discount that provides free or discounted usage of a service or feature based on the usage of another service or feature. Credit: Any credits that AWS applied to your bill. See the Description column for details. AWS might update reports after they've been finalized, if AWS applies a credit to your account for the month after finalizing your bill. Discount: Any discounts that AWS applied to your usage. This specific line item name may vary and require parsing based on the discount. For more information, refer to the lineItem/LineItemDescription column. DiscountedUsage: The rate of any instances for which you had Reserved Instance (RI) benefits. Fee: Any upfront annual fee that you paid for subscriptions. For example, the upfront fee that you paid for an All Upfront RI or a Partial Upfront RI. Refund: The negative charges that AWS refunded money for. Review the Description column for details. AWS might update reports after they've been finalized, if AWS applies a refund to your account for the month after finalizing your bill. RIFee: The monthly recurring fee for subscriptions. For example, the recurring fee for Partial Upfront RIs, No Upfront RIs, and All Upfronts that you pay every month. Although the RIFee might be $0 for all upfront reservations, this line is still populated for those reservation types to provide other columns such as reservation/AmortizedUpfrontFeeForBillingPeriod and reservation/ReservationARN. Tax: Any taxes that AWS applied to your bill. For example, VAT or US sales tax. Usage: Any usage that is charged at On-Demand Instance rates. SavingsPlanUpfrontFee: Any one-time upfront fee from your purchase of an All Upfront or Partial Upfront Savings Plan. SavingsPlanRecurringFee: Any recurring hourly charges that correspond with your No Upfront or Partial Upfront Savings Plan. The Savings Plan recurring fee is initially added to your bill on the day that you purchase a No Upfront or Partial Upfront Savings Plan. After the initial purchase, AWS adds the recurring fee to the first day of each billing period thereafter. SavingsPlanCoveredUsage: Any On-Demand cost that is covered by your Savings Plan. Savings Plan covered usage line items are offset by the corresponding Savings Plan negation items. SavingsPlanNegation – Any offset cost through your Savings Plan benefit that’s associated with the corresponding Savings Plan covered usage item. FlateRateSubscription - Any hourly subscription fee AWS applied to your bill for services with subscription fee. For example, Kiro Enterprise.

columns.name: line_item_net_unblended_cost
columns.description: The actual after-discount cost that you're paying for the line item. This column is only included in your report when your account has a discount in the applicable billing period.
columns.conditional_presence: only included when your account has a discount in the applicable billing period

columns.name: line_item_net_unblended_rate
columns.description: The actual after-discount rate that you're paying for the line item. This column is only included in your report when your account has a discount in the applicable billing period.
columns.conditional_presence: only included when your account has a discount in the applicable billing period

columns.name: line_item_normalization_factor
columns.description: As long as the instance has shared tenancy, AWS can apply all Regional Linux or Unix Amazon EC2 and Amazon RDS RI discounts to all instance sizes in an instance family and AWS Region. This also applies to RI discounts for member accounts in an organization. All new and existing Amazon EC2 and Amazon RDS size-flexible RIs are sized according to a normalization factor, based on the instance size.

columns.name: line_item_normalized_usage_amount
columns.description: The amount of usage that you incurred, in normalized units, for size-flexible RIs. The NormalizedUsageAmount is equal to UsageAmount multiplied by NormalizationFactor.

columns.name: line_item_operation
columns.description: The specific AWS operation covered by this line item. This describes the specific usage of the line item. For example, a value of RunInstances indicates the operation of an Amazon EC2 instance.

columns.name: line_item_product_code
columns.description: The code of the product measured. For example, Amazon EC2 is the product code for Amazon Elastic Compute Cloud.

columns.name: line_item_resource_id
columns.description: Table configuration: Added by: INCLUDE RESOURCES (Optional) If you chose to include individual resource IDs in your report, this column contains the ID of the resource that you provisioned. For example, an Amazon S3 storage bucket, an Amazon EC2 compute instance, or an Amazon RDS database can each have a resource ID. This field is blank for usage types that aren't associated with an instantiated host, such as data transfers and API requests, and line item types such as discounts, credits, and taxes.

columns.name: line_item_tax_type
columns.description: The type of tax that AWS applied to this line item.

columns.name: line_item_unblended_cost
columns.description: The UnblendedCost is the UnblendedRate multiplied by the UsageAmount.

columns.name: line_item_unblended_rate
columns.description: In consolidated billing for accounts using AWS Organizations, the unblended rate is the rate associated with an individual account's service usage. For Amazon EC2 and Amazon RDS line items that have an RI discount applied to them, the UnblendedRate is 0. Line items with an RI discount have a LineItemType of DiscountedUsage.

columns.name: line_item_usage_account_id
columns.description: The account ID of the account that used this line item. For organizations, this can be either the management account or a member account. You can use this field to track costs or usage by account.

columns.name: line_item_usage_amount
columns.description: The amount of usage that you incurred during the specified time period. For size-flexible Reserved Instances, use the reservation/TotalReservedUnits column instead. Certain subscription charges will have a UsageAmount of 0.

columns.name: line_item_usage_end_date
columns.description: The end date and time for the corresponding line item in UTC, exclusive. The format is YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm:ssZ.

columns.name: line_item_usage_start_date
columns.description: The start date and time for the line item in UTC, inclusive. The format is YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm:ssZ.

columns.name: line_item_usage_type
columns.description: The usage details of the line item. For example, USW2-BoxUsage:m2.2xlarge describes an M2 High Memory Double Extra Large instance in the US West (Oregon) Region.

columns.name: line_item_user_identifier
columns.description: The Identity Access Management (IAM) Identity Center identifier of a workforce user. The monthly flat-rate subscription and on-demand charges are calculated for the user identified by this identifier.

columns.name: pricing_currency
columns.description: The currency that the pricing data is shown in.

columns.name: pricing_lease_contract_length
columns.description: The length of time that your RI is reserved for.

columns.name: pricing_offering_class
columns.description: The offering class of the Reserved Instance.

columns.name: pricing_public_on_demand_cost
columns.description: The total cost for the line item based on public On-Demand Instance rates. If you have SKUs with multiple On-Demand public costs, the equivalent cost for the highest tier is displayed. For example, services offering free-tiers or tiered pricing.

columns.name: pricing_public_on_demand_rate
columns.description: The public On-Demand Instance rate in this billing period for the specific line item of usage. If you have SKUs with multiple On-Demand public rates, the equivalent rate for the highest tier is displayed. For example, services offering free-tiers or tiered pricing.

columns.name: pricing_purchase_option
columns.description: How you chose to pay for this line item. Valid values are All Upfront, Partial Upfront, and No Upfront.

columns.name: pricing_rate_code
columns.description: A unique code for a product/offer/pricing-tier combination. The product and term combinations can have multiple price dimensions, such as a free tier, low-use tier, and high-use tier.

columns.name: pricing_rate_id
columns.description: The ID of the rate for a line item.

columns.name: pricing_term
columns.description: Whether your AWS usage is Reserved or On-Demand.

columns.name: pricing_unit
columns.description: The pricing unit AWS used to calculate your usage cost. For example, the pricing unit for Amazon EC2 instance usage is in hours.

columns.name: product
columns.description: A map column containing key-value pairs of multiple product attributes and their values for a given line item. A product attribute only appears in the map column if it has a value that applies to the specific line item. NoteAny product column that appeared in legacy CUR, but is not part of the CUR 2.0 static schema, appears in this map column. The keys of this column can be queried as individual columns by using the dot operator. For more information, see Data query. For some AWS services, the map includes additional service-specific attributes. For the list of these attributes and the services that populate them, see Service-specific product attributes.

columns.name: product_comment
columns.description: A comment regarding the product.

columns.name: product_fee_code
columns.description: The code that refers to the fee.

columns.name: product_fee_description
columns.description: The description for the product fee.

columns.name: product_from_location
columns.description: Describes the location where the usage originated from.

columns.name: product_from_location_type
columns.description: Describes the location type where the usage originated from.

columns.name: product_from_region_code
columns.description: Describes the source Region code for the AWS service.

columns.name: product_instanceSKU
columns.description: The SKU of the product instance

columns.name: product_instance_family
columns.description: Describes your Amazon EC2 instance family. Amazon EC2 provides you with a large number of options across 10 different instance types, each with one or more size options, organized into distinct instance families optimized for different types of applications.

columns.name: product_instance_type
columns.description: Describes the instance type, size, and family, which define the CPU, networking, and storage capacity of your instance.

columns.name: product_location
columns.description: Describes the Region that your Amazon S3 bucket resides in.

columns.name: product_location_type
columns.description: Describes the endpoint of your task.

columns.name: product_operation
columns.description: Describes the specific AWS operation that this line item covers.

columns.name: product_pricing_unit
columns.description: The smallest billing unit for an AWS service. For example, 0.01c per API call.

columns.name: product_product_family
columns.description: The category for the type of product. For Amazon Bedrock line items, this is populated with the unified value Amazon Bedrock, so that all Amazon Bedrock usage can be identified under a single product family.

columns.name: product_region_code
columns.description: A Region is a physical location around the world where data centers are clustered. AWS calls each group of logical data centers an Availability Zone (AZ). Each AWS Region consists of multiple, isolated, and physically separate AZs within a geographical area. The Region code attribute has the same name as an AWS Region, and specifies where the AWS service is available.

columns.name: product_sku
columns.description: A unique code for a product. The SKU is created by combining the ProductCode, UsageType, and Operation. For size-flexible RIs, the SKU uses the instance that was used. For example, if you used a t2.micro instance and AWS applied a t2.small RI discount to the usage, the line item SKU is created with the t2.micro.

columns.name: product_servicecode
columns.description: This identifies the specific AWS service to the customer as a unique short abbreviation.

columns.name: product_to _location_type
columns.description: Describes the destination location of the service usage.
columns.note: nome reproduzido literalmente da documentacao, incluindo o espaco; ver divergencia 3 na spec .md

columns.name: product_to_location
columns.description: Describes the location usage destination.

columns.name: product_to_region_code
columns.description: Describes the source Region code for the AWS service.

columns.name: product_usagetype
columns.description: Describes the usage details of the line item.

columns.name: reservation_amortized_upfront_cost_for_usage
columns.description: The initial upfront payment for all upfront RIs and partial upfront RIs amortized for usage time. The value is equal to: RIAmortizedUpfrontFeeForBillingPeriod * The normalized usage amount for DiscountedUsage line items / The normalized usage amount for the RIFee. Because there are no upfront payments for no upfront RIs, the value for a no upfront RI is 0. We don't provide this value for Dedicated Host reservations at this time. The change will be made in a future update.

columns.name: reservation_amortized_upfront_fee_for_billing_period
columns.description: Describes how much of the upfront fee for this reservation is costing you for the billing period. The initial upfront payment for all upfront RIs and partial upfront RIs, amortized over this month. Because there are no upfront fees for no upfront RIs, the value for no upfront RIs is 0. We don't provide this value for Dedicated Host reservations at this time. The change will be made in a future update.

columns.name: reservation_availability_zone
columns.description: The Availability Zone of the resource that is associated with this line item.

columns.name: reservation_effective_cost
columns.description: The sum of both the upfront and hourly rate of your RI, averaged into an effective hourly rate. EffectiveCost is calculated by taking the amortizedUpfrontCostForUsage and adding it to the recurringFeeForUsage.

columns.name: reservation_end_time
columns.description: The end date of the associated RI lease term.

columns.name: reservation_modification_status
columns.description: Shows whether the RI lease was modified or if it is unaltered. Original: The purchased RI was never modified. System: The purchased RI was modified using the console or API. Manual: The purchased RI was modified using AWS Support assistance. ManualWithData: The purchased RI was modified using AWS Support assistance, and AWS calculated estimates for the RI.

columns.name: reservation_net_amortized_upfront_cost_for_usage
columns.description: The initial upfront payment for All Upfront RIs and Partial Upfront RIs amortized for usage time, if applicable. This column is included in your report only when your account has a discount in the applicable billing period.
columns.conditional_presence: only included when your account has a discount in the applicable billing period

columns.name: reservation_net_amortized_upfront_fee_for_billing_period
columns.description: The cost of the reservation's upfront fee for the billing period. This column is included in your report only when your account has a discount in the applicable billing period.
columns.conditional_presence: only included when your account has a discount in the applicable billing period

columns.name: reservation_net_effective_cost
columns.description: The sum of both the upfront fee and the hourly rate of your RI, averaged into an effective hourly rate. This column is included in your report only when your account has a discount in the applicable billing period.
columns.conditional_presence: only included when your account has a discount in the applicable billing period

columns.name: reservation_net_recurring_fee_for_usage
columns.description: The after-discount cost of the recurring usage fee. This column is included in your report only when your account has a discount in the applicable billing period.
columns.conditional_presence: only included when your account has a discount in the applicable billing period

columns.name: reservation_net_unused_amortized_upfront_fee_for_billing_period
columns.description: The net unused amortized upfront fee for the billing period. This column is included in your report only when your account has a discount in the applicable billing period.
columns.conditional_presence: only included when your account has a discount in the applicable billing period

columns.name: reservation_net_unused_recurring_fee
columns.description: The recurring fees associated with unused reservation hours for Partial Upfront and No Upfront RIs after discounts. This column is included in your report only when your account has a discount in the applicable billing period.
columns.conditional_presence: only included when your account has a discount in the applicable billing period

columns.name: reservation_net_upfront_value
columns.description: The upfront value of the RI with discounts applied. This column is included in your report only when your account has a discount in the applicable billing period.
columns.conditional_presence: only included when your account has a discount in the applicable billing period

columns.name: reservation_normalized_units_per_reservation
columns.description: The number of normalized units for each instance of a reservation subscription.

columns.name: reservation_number_of_reservations
columns.description: The number of reservations that are covered by this subscription. For example, one RI subscription might have four associated RI reservations.

columns.name: reservation_recurring_fee_for_usage
columns.description: The recurring fee amortized for usage time, for partial upfront RIs and no upfront RIs. The value is equal to: The unblended cost of the RIFee * The sum of the normalized usage amount of Usage line items / The normalized usage amount of the RIFee for size flexible Reserved Instances. Because all upfront RIs don't have recurring fee payments greater than 0, the value for all upfront RIs is 0.

columns.name: reservation_reservation_a_r_n
columns.description: The Amazon Resource Name (ARN) of the RI that this line item benefited from. This is also called the "RI Lease ID". This is a unique identifier of this particular AWS Reserved Instance. The value string also contains the AWS service name and the Region where the RI was purchased.

columns.name: reservation_start_time
columns.description: The start date of the term of the associated Reserved Instance.

columns.name: reservation_subscription_id
columns.description: A unique identifier that maps a line item with the associated offer. We recommend you use the RI ARN as your identifier of an AWS Reserved Instance, but both can be used.

columns.name: reservation_total_reserved_normalized_units
columns.description: The total number of reserved normalized units for all instances for a reservation subscription. AWS computes total normalized units by multiplying the reservation/NormalizedUnitsPerReservation with reservation/NumberOfReservations.

columns.name: reservation_total_reserved_units
columns.description: TotalReservedUnits populates for both Fee and RIFee line items with distinct values.

columns.name: reservation_units_per_reservation
columns.description: UnitsPerReservation populates for both Fee and RIFee line items with distinct values.

columns.name: reservation_unused_amortized_upfront_fee_for_billing_period
columns.description: The amortized-upfront-fee-for-billing-period-column amortized portion of the initial upfront fee for all upfront RIs and partial upfront RIs. Because there are no upfront payments for no upfront RIs, the value for no upfront RIs is 0. We don't provide this value for Dedicated Host reservations at this time. The change will be made in a future update.

columns.name: reservation_unused_normalized_unit_quantity
columns.description: The number of unused normalized units for a size-flexible Regional RI that you didn't use during this billing period.

columns.name: reservation_unused_quantity
columns.description: The number of RI hours that you didn't use during this billing period.

columns.name: reservation_unused_recurring_fee
columns.description: The recurring fees associated with your unused reservation hours for partial upfront and no upfront RIs. Because all upfront RIs don't have recurring fees greater than 0, the value for All Upfront RIs is 0.

columns.name: reservation_upfront_value
columns.description: The upfront price paid for your AWS Reserved Instance. For no upfront RIs, this value is 0.

columns.name: resource_tags
columns.description: A map column containing key-value pairs of resource tags and their values for a given line item. The values in this column are all of data type "string". Resource tag keys only appear in this column if they've been enabled as cost allocation tags in the Billing console. After being enabled, a particular key only appears in the map column if it has a value that applies to the specific line item. The keys of this column can be queried as individual columns using the dot operator. For more information, see Data query.

columns.name: savings_plan_amortized_upfront_commitment_for_billing_period
columns.description: The amount of upfront fee a Savings Plan subscription is costing you for the billing period. The initial upfront payment for All Upfront Savings Plan and Partial Upfront Savings Plan amortized over the current month. For No Upfront Savings Plan, the value is 0.

columns.name: savings_plan_end_time
columns.description: The expiration date for the Savings Plan agreement.

columns.name: savings_plan_instance_type_family
columns.description: The instance family that is associated with the specified usage.

columns.name: savings_plan_net_amortized_upfront_commitment_for_billing_period
columns.description: The cost of a Savings Plan subscription upfront fee for the billing period. This column is included in your report only when your account has a discount in the applicable billing period.
columns.conditional_presence: only included when your account has a discount in the applicable billing period

columns.name: savings_plan_net_recurring_commitment_for_billing_period
columns.description: The net unblended cost of the Savings Plan fee. This column is included in your report only when your account has a discount in the applicable billing period.
columns.conditional_presence: only included when your account has a discount in the applicable billing period

columns.name: savings_plan_net_savings_plan_effective_cost
columns.description: The effective cost for Savings Plans, which is your usage divided by the fees. This column is included in your report only when your account has a discount in the applicable billing period.
columns.conditional_presence: only included when your account has a discount in the applicable billing period

columns.name: savings_plan_offering_type
columns.description: Describes the type of Savings Plan purchased.

columns.name: savings_plan_payment_option
columns.description: The payment options available for your Savings Plan.

columns.name: savings_plan_purchase_term
columns.description: Describes the duration, or term, of the Savings Plan.

columns.name: savings_plan_recurring_commitment_for_billing_period
columns.description: The monthly recurring fee for your Savings Plan subscriptions. For example, the recurring monthly fee for a Partial Upfront Savings Plan or No Upfront Savings Plan.

columns.name: savings_plan_region
columns.description: The AWS Region (geographic area) that hosts your AWS services. You can use this field to analyze spend across a particular AWS Region.

columns.name: savings_plan_savings_plan_a_r_n
columns.description: The unique Savings Plan identifier.

columns.name: savings_plan_savings_plan_effective_cost
columns.description: The proportion of the Savings Plan monthly commitment amount (upfront and recurring) that is allocated to each usage line.

columns.name: savings_plan_savings_plan_rate

columns.name: split_line_item_parent_resource_id
columns.description: Table configuration: Added by: INCLUDE SPLIT COST ALLOCATION DATA The resource ID of the parent EC2 instance associated with the Amazon ECS task or Amazon EKS pod (referenced in the lineItem/ResourceId column). The parent resource ID implies that the ECS task or Kubernetes pod workload for the specified time period ran on the parent EC2 instance. This applies only for Amazon ECS tasks or Kubernetes pods with EC2 launch type.

columns.name: split_line_item_public_on_demand_split_cost
columns.description: Table configuration: Added by: INCLUDE SPLIT COST ALLOCATION DATA The cost for vCPU or memory (based on lineItem/UsageType) allocated for the time period to the Amazon ECS task or Kubernetes pod based on public On-Demand Instance rates (referenced in the pricing/publicOnDemandRate column).

columns.name: split_line_item_public_on_demand_unused_cost
columns.description: Table configuration: Added by: INCLUDE SPLIT COST ALLOCATION DATA The unused cost for vCPU or memory (based on lineItem/UsageType) allocated for the time period to the Amazon ECS task or Kubernetes pod based on public On-Demand Instance rates. Unused costs are costs associated with resources (CPU or memory) on the EC2 instance (referenced in the splitLineItem/ParentResourceIdcolumn) that were not utilized for the specified time period.

columns.name: split_line_item_reserved_usage
columns.description: Table configuration: Added by: INCLUDE SPLIT COST ALLOCATION DATA The usage for vCPU, memory, or accelerator resources (based on lineItem/UsageType) that you configured for the specified time period for the Amazon ECS task or Kubernetes pod.

columns.name: split_line_item_split_cost
columns.description: Table configuration: Added by: INCLUDE SPLIT COST ALLOCATION DATA The cost for vCPU or memory (based on lineItem/UsageType) allocated for the time period to the Amazon ECS task or Kubernetes pod. This includes amortized costs if the EC2 instance (referenced in the splitLineItem/parentResourceId column) has upfront or partial upfront charges for reservations or Savings Plans.

columns.name: split_line_item_split_usage
columns.description: Table configuration: Added by: INCLUDE SPLIT COST ALLOCATION DATA The usage for vCPU or memory (based on lineItem/UsageType) allocated for the specified time period to the Amazon ECS task or Kubernetes pod. This is defined as the maximum usage of splitLineItem/ReservedUsage or splitLineItem/ActualUsage.

columns.name: split_line_item_split_usage_ratio
columns.description: Table configuration: Added by: INCLUDE SPLIT COST ALLOCATION DATA The ratio of vCPU, memory, or accelerator resources (based on lineItem/UsageType) allocated to the Amazon ECS task or Kubernetes pod compared to the overall CPU, memory, or accelerator resources available on the EC2 instance (referenced in the splitLineItem/ParentResourceId column).

columns.name: split_line_item_unused_cost
columns.description: Table configuration: Added by: INCLUDE SPLIT COST ALLOCATION DATA The unused cost for vCPU, memory, or accelerator resources (based on lineItem/UsageType) allocated for the time period to the Amazon ECS task or Kubernetes pod. Unused costs are costs associated with resources (CPU, memory, or accelerator resources) on the EC2 instance (referenced in the splitLineItem/ParentResourceId column) that were not utilized for the specified time period. This includes amortized costs if the EC2 instance (splitLineItem/parentResourceId) has upfront or partial upfront charges for reservations or Savings Plans.

columns.name: tags
columns.description: A map column containing key-value pairs of all tags and their values for a given line item. The values in this column are all of data type "string". Tag keys only appear in this column if they've been enabled as cost allocation tags in the Billing console. After being enabled, a particular key only appears in the map column if it has a value that applies to the specific line item. The keys of this column can be queried as individual columns using the dot operator. For more information, see Data query.

counts.count_method: Rows extracted from the official HTML of each table-dictionary-cur2-* column group page. The second table on the product page (Service-specific product attributes) is not columns and is excluded; those keys are listed in non_column_map_keys_verified.

The Metadata section and the Summary section of the same page document different file names.

unverified.item: Compression parameter value PARQUET equals Snappy
unverified.reason: PARQUET is a documented valid value of the Compression parameter, but the documentation never states it maps to Snappy. The only documented Parquet/Snappy link is the .snappy.parquet file extension.

unverified.item: Currency/unit of monetary CUR 2.0 columns (line_item_*_cost, pricing_public_on_demand_cost, reservation_*, savings_plan_*, discount_*)
unverified.reason: Field documentation describes semantics but never declares the currency unit. The only currency statement in the table is 'All AWS customers are billed in US dollars by default' on line_item_currency_code; the actual export currency is runtime-determined by line_item_currency_code and pricing_currency.

unverified.item: Unit of line_item_usage_amount, line_item_normalized_usage_amount and split_line_item_* usage columns
unverified.reason: Unit is service-dependent; the documentation refers to pricing_unit / lineItem/UsageType without a fixed value.
The delivery documentation defines only file names and the TEXT_OR_CSV format option; it makes no statement about header, delimiter or encoding.
